answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 37200 Country: India Title: My brother recently brought a fish aquarium in our home Question: My brother recently brought a fish aquarium in our home. Is it allowable to have living creature in home as a show piece? Answer ID: 37200 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 515/377/D=1433) It is allowed to keep fish aquarium in house for decoration, however one should take great care of food etc. في الشامي لا بأس بحبس الطيور والدجاج في بيته ولكن يعلفها الخ . شامي : 575/9 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
